fences.\n472\tfn extract_json_block(text: &str) -> Option<&str> {\n473\t    // Look for ```json ... ``` or ``` ... ``` blocks.\n474\t    if let Some(start) = text.find(\"```json\") {\n475\t        let content_start = start + \"```json\".len();\n476\t        if let Some(end) = text[content_start..].find(\"```\") {\n477\t            return Some(text[content_start..content_start + end].trim());\n478\t        }\n479\t    }\n480\t\n481\t    if let Some(start) = text.find(\"```\") {\n482\t        let content_start = start + \"```\".len();\n483\t        // Skip to next line if the opening ``` has text 1;\n503\t                    if depth == 0 {\n504\t                        return Some(&trimmed[..=i]);\n505\t                    }\n506\t                }\n507\t                _ => {}\n508\t            }\n509\t        }\n510\t    }\n511\t\n512\t    None\n513\t}\n514\t\n515\t/// Sanitize a path string for use as a filename component.\n516\tfn sanitize_path_component(s: &str) -> String {\n517\t    s.chars()\n518\t        .map(|c| {\n519\t            if c.is_alphanumeric() || c == '-' || c == '_' {\n520\t                c\n521\t            } else {\n522\t                '_'\n523\t            }\n524\t        })\n525\t        .collect()\n526\t}\n527\t\n528\t/// Check if two titles match (fuzzy comparison for dedup).\n529\t///\n530\t/// Considers titles matching if they are identical after
